description: CSV to chart spec (Vega-Lite) — Turn CSV into a ready-to-render Vega-Lite v5 chart spec. Infers column types (number, date/year, category) and picks the right chart: line for trends over time, sorted bar for comparisons, scatter for two numbers, histogram for one number, pie only for 8 or fewer slices, heatmap for two categories. Returns the spec with data inlined (up to 500 rows), the reason, column types and alternatives. Optional: x=, y=, color= column names; goal=trend|compare|distribution|relationship|share; title=. Offline, nothing stored. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_chart_spec
